device.description: 16-bit 3 MSPS dual simultaneous-sampling SAR ADC with internal reference and enhanced-SPI interface (1/2/4 SDO per channel, DDR, clock re-timer, parallel byte)
device.note: ads9234r.pdf (SBAS876C) p.3-4 pin configuration and functions, p.5 recommended operating conditions (DVDD 1.65-5.5 V), p.9 timing requirements, p.10 switching characteristics (tDRDY 315 ns ADS9224R, tDEN_CSDO 12 ns, tDZ_CSDO 12 ns, tD_CKDO 15.8 ns SDR), p.23 Table 1 (two's complement, mid code 0), p.26-27 functional modes (conversion on the CONVST rising edge; PD/RST low = reset or power-down, registers to default), p.28-29 zone 1 / zone 2 frames, p.30 READY output (high when data ready, low after CS falls; masked by READY_MASK) and Table 2 / Figure 46 output data word, p.31 Table 3 SPI-xy-S-SDR (power-up SPI-00-S-SDR: ADC_A on SDO-0A, ADC_B on SDO-0B), p.41 Table 8 (SPI-00-S for configuring), p.42 command frame and Table 9 commands, p.43-48 register map

registers.name: DEVICE_STATUS
registers.note: p.44 Table 12: sticky flags, write 1 to clear

commands.name: NOP0
commands.note: p.42 Table 9: conversion control and reading results

commands.name: READ
commands.note: p.42 Table 9 note 1: the register data come in the next frame's output data word (p.30 Table 2 note 1); the position of the 8 register bits in the 16-bit word is not given (modeled MSB first, zeros after)

pages: p.3-4 (pinout), p.5 (ROC), p.9 (timing requirements), p.10-11 (switching characteristics), p.23 (transfer function), p.26-29 (functional modes, reset / power-down, zone 1 / zone 2 frames), p.30 (READY/STROBE, output data word), p.31-39 (read protocols), p.41 (configuration protocol), p.42 (command frame, Table 9), p.43-48 (register map)
notModeled: only the power-up read protocol SPI-00-S-SDR is modeled: channel A on SDO-0/0A (the bus miso); channel B's word on SDO-4/0B is never driven (the schema has one miso). Dual / quad SDO (BUS_WIDTH), DDR, clock re-timer (STROBE output) and parallel byte protocols (SDO_PROTOCOL, CRT_CFG, PARALLEL_MODE_DATA_FORMAT) are stored only
SPI_CPOL / SPI_CPHA select the SPI mode for both reading and writing; the model stays in mode 0 (the reset value)
analog inputs, internal reference, reference buffers and REFby2 (POWER_DOWN_CFG, REFBY2_OFFSET stored only): the result is always the 0 V code 0 (two's complement)
zone 1 / zone 2 transfers: the frame shows the most recent completed conversion; DEVICE_STATUS.ZONE2_TRANSFER is never set
data averaging (DATA_AVG_CFG, AVG_ERROR flag) not modeled
READ: the datasheet does not say where the 8 register bits sit in the next 16-bit output word; modeled as the first 8 bits followed by zeros
fixed pattern A55AA55Ah: the model shifts A55Ah (its first 16 bits, equal to the last 16) on SDO-0A

PD/RST: a low pulse of 50-500 ns resets, a pulse >= 1 us powers down (both reset the registers); modeled as a reset pin held active while low; wake-up times (1 us / up to 150 ms) and the 0.9 ms power-up READY high state are not modeled
READY/STROBE: READY (active high) while CS is high; STROBE (held low outside CRT protocols) while CS is low. Modeled as ready, cleared at CS fall
the host must keep CONVST high while writing / reading registers (not checked)
skeleton device id ADS9224 is the ADS9224R (orderable ADS9224RIRHBT)
variants: ADS9224R (16-bit, 3 MSPS, tDRDY 315 ns) and ADS9234R (14-bit, 3.5 MSPS, tDRDY 280 ns, left / right alignment) share ads9234r.pdf and the pinout; own spec files
